editorial:
Imagine your kid gets locked up for a mistake and the law won't budge. That's the nightmare John Matthews faces when his estranged son Jason is busted for drug trafficking and hit with a harsh mandatory minimum sentence. Desperate, John makes a deal with the DEA and a hungry DA to go undercover himself, trading big arrests for his son's freedom. With help from an ex-con employee, he dives into the dangerous drug world where one wrong move could cost everything.

The Rock delivers a surprisingly grounded performance, showing real fear and determination instead of just flexing. The action feels tense and believable, with solid pacing that keeps you on edge. Some scenes drag a bit and the plot gets convenient, but the emotional core lands. If you enjoy grounded thrillers with heart, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the finale, John's undercover work leads to a major drug bust involving cartel members. The DEA arrests the big players, and John narrowly escapes danger. Because of his cooperation, Jason's sentence is reduced and he is freed. John survives the operation and reunites with his son, proving his sacrifice paid off.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves grounded thrillers with emotional stakes.
